one_liner: Lark Open Platform offers a broad REST API with user_access_token (OAuth) and app-based tenant_access_token; custom apps can be created self-serve, though Starter is capped at 10,000 basic calls/month and an official MCP server is reported but not confirmed by the fetched pages.
auth_notes: user_access_token acts on behalf of a user (OAuth-based); tenant_access_token is the app's own identity, minted by the app (classed OTHER). Tokens are sent as Authorization: Bearer and last up to 7200 seconds. Permission scopes for custom apps may require tenant admin review. The pages do not spell out the OAuth grant details, so the OAuth2 label is a reasonable inference.
access_notes: Homepage has a CREATE APP entry point. Billing page shows custom apps on the Starter edition are limited to 10,000 basic API calls per month; Basic, PRO and Enterprise have unlimited basic calls. Advanced APIs need a purchased quota package (Basic/PRO/Enterprise only). Whether Starter is free is not stated in the fetched pages.
blocker_notes: Per-tenant setup: sensitive scopes need review/approval by the tenant's app administrator. Starter tenants have a 10,000 basic call/month quota, and advanced APIs require purchased quota.
